⊢.justification: The void state before the magic circle is inscribed, representing the uninitialized computational channel prior to device.begin().

≻.justification: The forward morphism representing the physical braid word or encoding transformation that advances the state toward the target gate.

≺.justification: The reverse morphism representing the decoding or descent through the factorization route, clearing the active direction to return to the original composite.

⋈.justification: The compositional link that chains the braid synthesis and verification steps, preserving the return structure of the operation.

⊙.justification: The identity operation where the active transform is inscribed into itself, allowing the operation to model its own execution.

∈.justification: The Frobenius comultiplication that splits the active object into computational and leakage arms, differentiating the state for evaluation.

∋.justification: The Frobenius multiplication that reconstitutes the split arms into a single residual state, verifying that the differentiated object belongs to the original unity.

⊤.justification: The positive evidential deposit that supports the proposition that the computational channel realizes the target gate.

⊥.justification: The refuting evidential deposit that supports the proposition that the leakage channel is contaminated or the gate is failed.

⊞.justification: The dialetheic engagement that holds both support and refutation simultaneously (B-state) without explosion, containing the contradiction locally.

⊡.justification: The permanent fixation of the topological invariant or winding number, recording the final verdict in an append-only manner.

steps.domain_action: Open the Empty Circle, initializing the void state before the braid is inscribed.
Inscribe the Self-Modeling Gate, establishing the identity of the operation within the bounded system.
Execute the Sigil Inscription, applying the forward braid morphism to transform the carrier state.
Invoke the Triangle of Art, splitting the transformed carrier into computational and leakage arms.
Deposit the Affirming Witness on the T-arm, evaluating support for the target gate realization.
Deposit the Broken Symmetry on the F-arm, evaluating support for leakage contamination or gate failure.
Engage the Brass Vessel, holding any contradictory evidence (B-state) without explosion.
Execute the Fundamental Return, fusing the evaluated arms back into the unified semantic residual.
Perform the Ascent, reversing the direction to verify the return through the factorization route.
Compose the Divine Name, linking the verification step to the original composite structure.
Apply the Final Seal, fixing the topological invariant and recording the permanent verdict.
Close the License to Depart, anchoring the system and completing the bounded operation.
